question: Who is likely to start this fixture, appear, and play how many minutes?

recent_evidence.note: The latest five completed matches are used. During the season transition, the new season is the primary navigator, preseason confirms current personnel, and the old season becomes a fallback. Unlabelled historical backtests retain weight 1.0. Each older match retains 75% of the next-newer match's weight and cross-competition evidence is additionally discounted.

shape.note: Up to three exact declared XIs vote on the tactical role shape. Player Alpha Ability is not part of the vote.

tuning.selected_on: mean exact-XI starter hits in the earlier chronological development sample

selection.note: The latest competitive XI is the strongest manager-intent signal within the same competition. The 30-minute persistence bonus with suppression after a competition switch won across the first 60% chronological development sample and is judged only on the untouched final 40%. All five-match evidence and the shape vote remain active after a switch; only the single-XI bonus is suppressed. Preseason receives no single-XI bonus because split squads and experimental lineups made its latest formation unreliable.

minutes.formula: P(start) * E(minutes | start) + (P(appear) - P(start)) * E(minutes | substitute)
minutes.note: Raw expectations remain visible. A separate capped allocation is normalized to 990 team minutes for downstream team aggregation.

decision_boundaries.activation_gate: Passed on the final 40% chronological holdout: higher XI hit rate with no worse expected-minutes MAE, formation accuracy, or role-shape accuracy. Future changes require a new version and later holdout.
